answer: A sybil attacker needs many identities, so require each one to pass a delay-based age gate: an identity gains voting weight only after posting a small refundable bond and surviving many epochs. Weight rises slowly from a river of tiny steps toward a zenith cap, like carving marble. Cloning 1,000 identities then costs 1,000 locked bonds plus months of waiting, and slashing forfeits them if caught.
